title: Limitless Endurance
description: 10-minute EMOM followed by an 8-minute AMRAP with walking lunges, V-ups and jump squats

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower thighs parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower chest to the floor

exercises.name: Burpees without push-up
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Move forward in continuous lunges, big steps

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs together to touch your feet

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, touch your feet with your hands

exercises.name: Jump squats
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a jump, cushion the landing

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
